visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor living room, a toddler wearing a white t-shirt stands near a doorway, throwing green and yellow plastic toys toward an older boy sitting near a large purple sofa. The older boy flinches and rubs his leg while variety captions in Chinese appear. (2) A woman with reddish hair, wearing a grey t-shirt and black skirt, enters the frame and lifts the toddler into her arms. The older boy, now sitting on the floor, points toward his foot with an upset facial expression as the woman observes. (3) The scene shifts to the woman sitting on the sofa, holding the toddler while looking at the older boy's foot. She uses her hand to check for injuries. The older boy sits beside her, still looking distressed, with variety captions highlighting the emotional tension. (4) The woman continues to hold the toddler, who has calmed down, while the older boy sits nearby. A calico cat is visible on the floor, watching the family. The woman talks to the boy, who starts to relax and smile as they reconcile. (5) The older boy lies on the sofa, carefully holding a milk bottle and feeding the toddler. Both children are smiling and laughing. The woman’s hand reaches out to gently stroke the older boy’s cheek in an affectionate gesture of approval and gratitude.

Sharp, percussive sounds of plastic toys impacting the floor are heard, followed by high-pitched, excited babbling from a toddler. The environment has a clean, indoor resonance with very low ambient room tone. (2) The older boy begins to whine and cry with a high-pitched, distressed vocal tone. A woman’s voice enters, delivering speech at a moderate rate and calm volume, addressing the situation. The BGM continues softly as the children's cries become the dominant signal. (3) High-arousal vocalizations from both children crying simultaneously create a dense audio layer. The woman's voice shifts to a lower, soothing pitch with a friendly tone, attempting to comfort them. There are frequent pauses as she waits for the children's crying to subside. (4) The BGM swells slightly in volume, maintaining a happy tempo. A distinct, sharp cat 'meow' punctuates the mix. The woman’s voice is heard again, now with a high-valence, animated tone, narrating the reconciliation between the siblings. Laughter from the children is audible. (5) Soft, rhythmic sounds of a baby drinking from a bottle are heard, alongside the woman's warm, professional narrative voice. She speaks with a clear articulation and positive valence, thanking the older boy. The audio concludes with gentle laughter and the fading acoustic BGM.
